m: अपोभ् (√ उभ्), (Imper. 2. pl. अपोम्भत) to bind, fetter, AV. viii, 8, 11.

v: tri॰ apa--vaha--kta । 1 nirastetyakte 2 “kalpanApoQamaBrAntaM pratyakzaM nirvikalpakam” sa॰ da॰ ।
m: अपोढ mfn. (√ वह्), carried off, removed, taken away.
a: अपोढ — p. p. Carried away, removed &c. See above.

m: अपोद्-√ 1. ऊह् to strip off, TBr.

v: tri॰ apagatamudakaM suSlizwatvAt yasya । 1 apravizwodake “tamUhaTurnOBirAtmanvatIBirantarikzaprudBirapodakABiH f॰ 1, 116, 3 । apanadDaM PalezUdakaM yasyAH uktapuMskatvAt striyAmata ittvaM vA । ittvapakze'podikApi (pui) pUtikAyAm tatPalezu udakavattvAttaTAtvam । apakfzwamudakaM yasmAt 5 ba॰ । jalApakarzahetO vizAdO “yatra apodakaM viDaM tatta etAsvagraBavam aTa॰ 5, 13, 1
m: अपोदक mf(आ)n. waterless, watertight, RV. i, 116, 3
a: अपोदक — a. Ved. 1 Waterless; water-tight (नौः Rv. 1. 116. 3). --2 Not watery, not fluid. --कं [ अपकृष्टमुदकं यस्मात्] Poison &c. that removes water (जलापकर्षहेतुविषादि).

m: अपोद्-इ (√ इ) to go away altogether, withdraw from (abl.), AV.; ŚBr.; AitBr.

s: strI, (apagatamudakaM yasyAH sA, striyAM wAp, pfzodarAditvAt dittvaM .) upodikA । pUtikASAkaM । ityamarawIkAyAM svAmI ॥
m: अपोदिका f. the pot-herb Basella Rubra or Lucida, L.
a: अपोदिका — f. A sort of potherb ( अपनद्धमुदकं यस्याः, तत्फलेषूदकवत्त्वात्तथात्वं).

m: अपोद्-इत्य (mfn.) n. impers. to be completely gone away from (abl.), ŚBr.

a: अपोगंडः — [अ-पोगंडः, or अपसि (वैध) कर्मणि गंडः त्याज्यः Tv.] 1 Having a limb too many or too few (redundant or deficient). --2 Not under 16 years of age; बाल आषोडशाद्वर्षात्पोगंडश्चापि संज्ञितः . Nārada; Ms. 8. 148; पोगंडः पंचमादब्दादर्वाक् च दशमाब्दतः . --3 A child or infant (किशोर, शिशु) --4 Very timid; --5 Wrinkled, flaccid. --6 One past 16.

s: tri, (apakfzwakarmmaRi vedavihitakAryyAdanyakarmmaRi gaRqaH udyataH, gaqi udyame + pacAdyac, nipAtanAt apaSabdasyAkArasya ukAraH, apasi karmmaRi gaRqaH atiBIrutvAt tyAjyaH .) svaBAvato nyUnADikANgaviSizwaH । tatparyyAyaH । pogaRqaH 2 vikalANgaH 3 aNgahInakaH 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ SiSuH । valiBaH । trivaliyuktaH । iti medinI ॥ atiBIruH । iti viSvo hemacandraSca ॥ dve svaBAvato nyUnADikANge UnaviMSatyaNgulIkEkaviMSatyaNgulIkAdO jane varttate ityarTaH । vikalaM svaBAvahInaM aNgamasya vikalANgaH । apakfzwaM gacCati apogaRqaH । nAmnIti gamerqaH nipAtanAt pasya poBAvaH । “apogaRqastu SiSuke vikalANge ca BIruke” । iti viSvaH ॥ nipAtanAdapasyAdilope pogaRqo'pi । pogaRqo vikalANge syAditi halAyuDaH ॥ pogaRqo vikalANgakaH । iti ratnakozaH । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ।
v: tri॰ apasi karmmaRi gaRqaH tyAjyaH । vikalANge “vikalANgaM hi sarvatra DarmmakAryyezu varjjayediti” smftteH sa hi vEDakarmmasu tyAjyaH । 2 atiBIrO so'pi hi karmamAtre tyAjyaH । apasi agaRqaH avIra iti vA tasya karmaRi avIratvAttaTAtvam । apojalamiva BaNgiyuktatvAt gaRqa ekadeSo'sya । 3 tribaliyute maDyaBAge balInAmeva tasya taraNgAkAratvAt taTAtvam । apasi karmaRi tyAjyaH gaRqaH apawutvAt pogaRqaH SiSuH na॰ ta॰ । pogaRqaH paYcamAdabdAdarvAk ca daSamAbdatEtyukte paYcAbde bAle । pogaRqaBinnaSiSoreva taTAtvAt । “bAla AzoqaSAt varzAt pogaRdaSceti Sabdayata” iti nAradoktapogaRqaBinne 5 zoqaSavarzAtItavayaske ca “ajaqaScedapogaRqo vizaye cAsya Bujyate BagnaM tadvyavahAreRa BoktA taddravyamarhati” kAtyA॰ ।
m: अ-पोगण्ड mfn. not under sixteen years of age, Mn. viii, 148
having a limb too many or too few, L.

k.v: विकलाङ्गस्त्वपोगण्डः खर्वो ह्रस्वश्च वामनः। खरणाः स्यात्खरणसो विग्रस्तु गतनासिकः॥

m: अपोह् (√ 1. ऊह्), -ऊहति (impf. अपौहत्) to strip off, push away, frighten away, RV. &c., to remove or heal (diseases), Suśr.; Ā. to keep away from one's self, avoid, Mn.; to give up, Ragh.; (in disputation) to object, deny, Sāh.
a: अपोह् — {c1c} U. [अप-उह् or ऊह्] 1 To remove, drive or push away, dispel, take away, destroy; स हि विघ्नानपोहति Ś. 3. 1; कुसुमानि… प्रभवंत्यायुरपोहितुं यदि R. 8. 44, 54; पूर्वमुत्सवमपौहदुत्सवः (उत्तरः) 19. 5 pushed away, displaced, supplanted; V. 3. 10; अकिंचिदपि कुर्वाणः सौख्यैर्दुःखान्यपोहति U. 2. 19 removes; Bk. 17. 83; 15. 119; Ms. 8. 414, 11. 108; कल्पनाया अपोढः कल्पनापोढः P. II. 1. 38 Sk. removed from, or beyond, imagination. --2 To heal, cure (as illness). --3 To avoid, give up, leave; Ms. 10. 86; पंचवट्यां ततो रामः… अनपोढस्थितिस्तस्थौ R. 12. 31 not leaving (the path of) propriety. --4 To deny; स्थाप्यतेऽपोह्यते वा चेत् S. D. 730. --5 To reason, argue by way of opposing a statement.

s: puM, (ap + Uha + BAve GaY .) apagataUhaH । vitarkABAvaH । SuSrUzAdyazwaDADIguRAntargatazazWaguRaH । (“SuSrUzA SravaRaM cEva grahaRaM DAraRaM taTA । Uho'paho'rTavijYAnaM tattvajYAnaM ca DIguRAH”) ॥ iti hemacandraH ॥ atadvyAvfttiH । iti kAvyaprakASawIkAyAM maheSvaraH ॥
v: pu॰ apa + uha gatyAdO bA॰ BAve ka । 1 tyAge 2 atadvyAvfttO tadBinnasya vyAvftterapi tyAgaviSezarUpatvAttaTAtvam । “tadvAnapoho vA SabdArTa” iti kAvyapra॰ “apohaH atadvyAvfttiriti” maheSvaraH । UhastarkaH apaH viparItye prA॰ sa॰ । aparatarkanirAsAya kfte viparItatarke sa ca “suSrUzA SravaRaM cEva grahaRaM DAraRA taTA । Uho'poho'rTavijYAnaM tattvajYAnaYca DIguRA iti hemacandroktaH budDiguRaBedaH । “svayamUhApohAsamarTa” iti pA॰ BA॰ । BAve lyuw । apohanamapyatra na॰ । “mattaH smftirjYAmamapohanaYceti” gItA ।
a: अपोहः — 1 Removing, driving away, healing &c. --2 Removal of doubt by the exercise of the reasoning faculty. --3 Reasoning, arguing; reasoning faculty. --4 Negative reasoning (opp. ऊह) (अपरतर्कनिरासाय कृतो विपरीतस्तर्कः), one of the dhīgunas q. v.; स्वयमूहापोहासमर्थः Mbh.; ऊहापोहमिमं सरोजनयना यावद्विधत्तेतरां Bv. 2. 74; hence ऊहापोह = complete discussion of a question. --5 Excluding all things not coming under the category in point; तद्वानपोहो वा शब्दार्थः (where Maheśvara paraphrases अपोह by अतद्व्यावृत्ति i. e. तद्भिन्नत्यागः)

m: अपोहनीय mfn. to be taken away, or removed, or expiated.

a: अपोहनं — 1 Removal &c. = अपोह above. --2 Reasoning faculty; मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च Bg. 15. 15 (Mr. Telang translates अ˚ by removal).

v: tri॰ apa--uha gatyAdO karmmaRi Ryat । apagamanIye “tyAjye etErvratErapohyaM syAdenohiMsAsamudBavam” manuH apa + vaha--lyap । dUrIkftyetyarTe avya॰ ।
a: अपोह्य, अपोहनीय — pot. p. To be removed, taken away, expiated (as sin); to be established by reason.

v: tri॰ apaH jalaM tadAtmakaM tadvikAratvAt apas + mayaw । jalamaye ।
tri॰ aponapAt devatA'sya Ga--Ca vA ni॰ । aponapAddevatAke havirAdO ।

m: अपोर्णवन n. untying Comm. on ĀpŚr.
अपोर्णु (√ ऊर्णु), अप ऊर्णोति, अपोर्णुते, once अपोर्णौति [KātyŚr.], to uncover, unveil, open, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. : Ā. to uncover one's self, TS.; ŚBr.
